I couldn't add the `--instance` option to `clever ssh`. Both edits to `src/commands/ssh/ssh.command.js` were refused because write permission wasn't granted. The repo is unchanged, and I haven't run `npm run docs` or `npm run validate`.

This is what I was going to change in that file:
- **Option:** add `instance`, an optional string option `--instance <instance-id>`, described as "Connect to a specific running instance by its ID".
- **Handler:** when `--instance` is set, look it up among the app's running instances and use its ID as the SSH target. If no running instance has that ID, throw "Instance <id> not found among the running instances of this application". Without the option, the current behavior stays the same.

If you grant write access, I'll redo the edits. After that I'll run `npm run docs` to regenerate `ssh.docs.md`, then `npm run validate`.
